pt-size.text: 9 · iPhone 17: new and delete with the fix

pn-size.text:
The approved fix from row 8 on iPhone 17 (402 × 874), as new transaction then delete (24 Nov 2026). Not built yet.

The form stops at the top of the bottom bar, Cancel and Add Transaction sit right above it, and only the category grid scrolls.

Delete: the sheet slides up over the whole screen, bar included, with Delete and Cancel full width.

Tablets and desktop (768 px wide and up) use the centred dialog, which this change doesn't touch.

n-design.text: This page is the live app as it is today. Changes proposed for it, each drawn as Before and After side by side, are on the "Proposed changes" page (page menu, top left).

n-how.text:
How the boards are built: each screen is one component board (Main = Transactions, Dashboard, Budgets, Categories, Investments, Loans, Recurring, SignIn; Loans also draws Instalments through its kind prop) that draws every state at both sizes, chosen by props: size is phone (iPhone 402 × 874, under 768 px wide) or desktop (1440 × 900). The other boards are small wrappers that mount it with different props, so a change to a screen is made once, in its component. Navigation lives in Nav. Every delete asks through one confirm dialog, drawn once in Confirm; the delete boards lay it over the screen it comes from.

Proposed changes: the components take a proposed prop. Off (the default, used on this page) draws the live app; on draws the proposal. The Proposed changes page sets it on its After boards.

Images: the app icon, the Google logo and every Ant Design icon the app uses are uploaded to this canvas's image store and referenced as /_blob/ links. The icons are drawn through one shared stylesheet (also uploaded) as masks, so they take the text colour. That stylesheet also carries the app's own tokens and classes from src/index.css. A second uploaded stylesheet adds the classes from the live release b57ac88 (search in the title row, tappable spending rows, the full-screen phone form, the amount keypad).

Follows the live site, financial-app-zy.vercel.app, as of 23 November 2026: its layout, with sample data in place of the owner's real accounts and amounts. Today is Monday 23 November 2026, amounts in RM.

pn-bar.text:
Approved 24 Nov 2026, not built yet. The Design page's phone form boards (new, amount keypad, delete) now draw this look; the Before board here keeps the live one. Seen on the phone (live): the bottom bar shows under the form, and Cancel / Add Transaction run into it; an empty strip sits between the categories and the buttons; and dragging on the button row moves the page.

Before: the live form with the bar drawn on top, as on the phone.

After:
• The form stops at the top of the bottom bar. The bar stays on screen and still works.
• The buttons sit right above the bar, with no line over them. The category grid runs down to the button row: 12 px from the last row to the buttons, instead of about 40.
• Only the category grid scrolls. The title, the fields and the button row never move; dragging on them does nothing.

The edit board shows the same footer with Delete, Cancel and Save Changes.

pn-cat.text:
Built and live since 23 Nov 2026 (commit c4f82ce), and drawn on the Design page. The Before boards here keep the old look.

The real categories, as on the live site. Every one shows an emoji that looks like the thing instead of a line icon, with no tile background behind it. Fluent Emoji Flat images, the set the note app uses (MIT licence).

Expense: 🍴 Food & Drinks, 🛍️ Shopping, 🚗 Car, 🧾 Bills & Fees, 🚆 Transport, 🛒 Groceries, 🎬 Entertainment, 🎾 Sports & Hobbies, 💊 Healthcare, ✂️ Beauty, 🎁 Gifts, 🐈‍⬛ Cat, ✈️ Travel, 🏠 Home, 📚 Education, 🏷️ Other.
Income: 💰 Salary, 🎉 Bonus, 👛 Allowance, 🪙 Cash Back, 🏷️ Other, 🎁 Gifts, 📋 Claims, 💵 Extra Income, 🏦 Savings.

Car and Cat are the real ones: the car is recoloured to #383838 and the cat to black, each with a thin light outline so they show on the dark panel. Car's category colour becomes #383838 (live #9aa3ad).

The category form's Icon field would become an emoji picker.

pn-dash.text:
Built and live since 23 Nov 2026 (commit c4f82ce), and drawn on the Design page. The Before boards here keep the old look.

Money: net worth reads "− RM 351,693.18" (was "RM -351,693.18"); assets, liabilities and yearly gain get 2 decimals; account rows say RM instead of MYR, with a space after the minus.

Row labels, approved 23 Nov 2026: the second line stops repeating the group. Investments show the symbol, with type, units and gain underneath; loans show rate type, rate and months paid; instalments show the monthly amount and months paid; bank accounts and cards keep type · bank. The labels board just left of this note compares them with today's.

pn-del.text:
Built and live since 23 Nov 2026 (commit c4f82ce), and drawn on the Design page. The Before boards here keep the old look.

Before: Ant Design's stock confirm. "Delete?" with no name, a yellow warning icon, small 32 px buttons and a different red from the rest of the app.

After: the app's own form style. A 16 px panel, a red bin chip, a title that names the thing, a line saying exactly what goes, and the app's 42 px pill buttons. On phone it is a bottom sheet with full-width Delete and Cancel.

Same change for budget, category, instalment and loan-adjustment deletes.

pn-form.text:
Approved 23 Nov 2026, not built yet. The Design page now draws this form on every board that opens it (new, amount keypad, edit, delete); the Before boards here keep the old one.

Order: Account | Amount on one row, then Date, Note, Category.

Date (option E from the options board): one full-width field that names the day in words ("Today, 23 Nov"). A pill inside swaps to Yesterday in one tap (and back to Today); tapping the field opens the calendar.

Category: every category on show as a round icon with its name underneath, one tap to pick, instead of a dropdown; the picked one gets a green ring. 4 a row on phone, 6 on desktop.

Rows, top to bottom: expense, income, transfer. Income shows the income categories. A transfer has no category (live asks for one): it keeps the live Transfer To field under Account | Amount, then Date and Note.

No page scroll: Type, Account | Amount, Date and Note stay put and Cancel / Add stay pinned at the bottom; only the category grid scrolls, inside the space left between them (on a shorter phone, or with the keypad open). On phone the form covers the bottom bar.

Try it: the After boards (and the Design page boards) are interactive (tap a tile, Yesterday, the tabs).

pn-insights.text:
Approved 23 Nov 2026: option B, and the Color field is gone from the category form (the picker boards above). Not built yet. The Design page now draws Insights this way; the Now board here keeps the old colours.

If the form stops asking for a colour, this is the only place it changes: the spending breakdown on Insights.

Now: each category shows the colour you picked. Picked colours repeat (Entertainment and Education are both blue, Healthcare and Beauty both red, most income categories the same blue), and the cat and the car are near-black slices that barely show on the dark panel.

Option A: the app gives each new category the next colour from a set of 12 that stay apart on the dark panel (Ant Design's chart colours). It is given once, when the category is made, so a category keeps its colour every month. You could still change it in the edit form.

Option B: the same colours, and the list shows each category's emoji instead of a plain square, with a small dot in its slice colour, so the rows read like the rest of the app.

pn-loans.text:
Built and live since 23 Nov 2026 (commit c4f82ce), and drawn on the Design page. The Before boards here keep the old look.

Loans: Borrowed, Total interest and the donut total get 2 decimals (RM 505,000.00, RM 481,048.00, RM 447,607.16).

Sidebar: the Loans icon becomes the account book the phone bar already uses (was a dollar coin). Visible on every After board.

Investments: price and average cost always 2 decimals; gains read "+ USD 1,212.50" and "+ RM 19,337.37".

pn-picker.text:
Approved 23 Nov 2026, not built yet. The Design page now draws this form wherever a category is added or edited; the Before boards here keep the old one.

The "Icon (optional)" text box, where you had to guess a word the app knows, becomes a picker: tap the emoji you want.

Suggested: about 100 Fluent Flat emoji chosen for a family budget in Malaysia, in groups (Food & drink, Transport, Home & bills, Family, Pets, Health & care, Shopping, Leisure & hobbies, Travel, Giving & occasions, Money & work, Finance & admin, Other). The chips on top filter to one group.

Search covers the whole Fluent set (1,595 emoji), so any category you make later can have its emoji without a code change. Tap the search field on the After boards to see a sample search for "pet".

No Color field: the app gives each new category its colour (see the Insights boards below). The form is Name, Type, then the picker.

The picked emoji shows inside the Name field and gets a green ring, as on the transaction form. Only the emoji grid scrolls; on phone the form becomes a full-screen page (like the transaction form) instead of a bottom sheet, so the grid has room. No scrollbars.

The car and the black cat are the app's own recoloured ones. Not built yet; the app needs the emoji files and stores the picked emoji's name in the icon column.

pn-tx.text:
Built and live since 23 Nov 2026 (commit c4f82ce), and drawn on the Design page. The Before boards here keep the old look.

Money: a sign then a space then RM, always 2 decimals: "+ RM 4,381.35", "− RM 12.50" (was "+RM", "−RM").

Month picker: drawn like the form fields, 44 tall with a 1.5 px border and 10 px corners (was a 32 px Ant Design picker).

Category icons: every category shows an emoji that looks like the thing (🍴 Food & Drinks, 🛒 Groceries, 🚆 Transport, 🧾 Bills & Fees, 🚗 Car, 🐈‍⬛ Cat…) instead of a line icon, with no tile background behind it. Fluent Emoji Flat images, the set the note app uses. Rows with no category keep the grey line icon on its tile.

Car becomes #383838 (live #9aa3ad), and the car itself is drawn in that colour; the cat is black. Both get a thin light outline so they show on the dark panel. The chart swatches in a very dark colour get a light rim.
